fiscal_impulse.desc: Change in the fiscal stance affecting demand

risk_premium.desc: Country risk premium over the foreign rate

energy_price.desc: Domestic energy price incl. carbon cost

climate_damage.desc: Output loss from physical climate impacts

bank_credit.desc: Bank credit to the private sector

bricks.name: Core: small open-economy gap model
bricks.summary: IS curve, Phillips curve and UIP for a small open economy. Every other brick plugs into it. Inputs from absent bricks fall back on the stubs below, so the core runs on its own.

requires.stub: exogenous path; contributes zero to the output gap beyond baseline
constant relative price (no energy cost channel)

checks: steady state residuals are zero
IRF signs to demand, supply, UIP and foreign shocks
stubbed inputs reproduce the stand-alone baseline

bricks.name: Rest of world (exogenous)
bricks.summary: Exogenous foreign environment: partner demand, foreign rate, world inflation and commodity prices, as scenario inputs.
checks: series come from a documented, dated vintage
scenario paths are internally consistent

bricks.name: Monetary policy: inflation-forecast / Taylor-type rule
bricks.summary: Policy rate responds to inflation and the output gap. Alternative to the managed-FX rule: both fill the same slot.
checks: determinacy (Taylor principle holds)
rule coefficients are sourced
response to supply and demand shocks is plausible

bricks.name: Fiscal block with debt-stabilizing rule
bricks.summary: Primary balance follows a debt-feedback rule; debt evolves with the real interest rate and growth (inflation is needed to turn the policy rate into a real rate). Receives resource and carbon revenue from bricks that supply them.
checks: debt dynamics identity closes exactly
rule is stabilizing (debt-feedback coefficient)
fiscal impulse sign convention matches the core

bricks.name: External sector: balance of payments and net foreign assets
bricks.summary: Current account, net foreign assets and a risk premium that responds to external debt. Closes the external accounts.
checks: balance-of-payments identity closes (errors and omissions reported)
NFA stationarity device is documented
valuation effects are explicit

bricks.name: Financial block: credit spread and accelerator
bricks.summary: External finance premium that rises when activity weakens; amplifies shocks. Replaces the core's constant-spread stub.
checks: spread and leverage moments match the data
amplification is quantified against the frictionless core

bricks.name: Output: fan charts
bricks.summary: Density forecasts and fan charts for key variables. Reads from the model; feeds nothing back.
checks: historical coverage of the bands is checked
method is labelled on the chart

bricks.name: Climate: energy, emissions and carbon pricing
bricks.summary: Energy prices including carbon cost, emissions and carbon revenue. The carbon price is a scenario lever.
checks: emissions accounting convention (scope, gases, production vs consumption) is stated
abatement cost assumptions are sourced
